title: Privacy Policy
description: How we collect, use, and protect personal information.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
paragraphs: We collect only the information needed to provide and improve our services.
This may include contact details, project requirements, and analytics events.

sections.heading: How We Use Information
paragraphs: We use your data to respond to inquiries, deliver services, and maintain security.
We do not sell personal information to third parties.

sections.heading: Data Retention
paragraphs: We keep personal data only for as long as needed for legal, operational, or contractual reasons.
You can request deletion of your personal data at any time, subject to legal obligations.

sections.heading: Your Rights
paragraphs: You may request access, correction, export, or deletion of your personal data.
Contact us by email to submit a privacy-related request.
